title: The 1 ms problem
lines: Two robot joints get the same command at the same time.
两个机器人关节，在同一时刻收到同样的命令。
Will they really move at the same moment?
它们真的会在同一瞬间动起来吗？
This course is about EtherCAT, the bus inside many robot joints.
这门课讲 EtherCAT，很多机器人关节里用的就是这条总线。
Before how it works, one question: why does timing matter so much?
讲它怎么工作之前，先回答一个问题：为什么时间这么要紧？

title: Our line
lines: Every episode uses the same small line.
每一集都用同一条小总线。
One master, then three slaves on one cable.
一个主站，后面一根网线串着三个从站。
Master: the controller that sends commands. Slave: a device that obeys and reports.
主站：发命令的控制器。从站：听命令、回数据的设备。
Slave 1 is an analog input card. Slaves 2 and 3 are joint drives, J1 and J2.
从站 1 是模拟量采集卡，从站 2 和 3 是两个关节驱动器：J1、J2。
The master is real open-source code, SOEM. The slaves are simulated chips.
主站是真实的开源代码 SOEM，从站是模拟出来的芯片。
Every number in this course comes from running it.
这门课里的每个数字，都来自真实运行。
Every 1 ms, the master sends J1 and J2 a new target position.
主站每 1 毫秒给 J1、J2 发一个新的目标位置。
Both follow the same slow wave, so they should always be in the same place.
两个关节走同一条缓慢的正弦曲线，所以它们应该永远在同一个位置。

title: Error = speed × time
zh: 误差 = 速度 × 时间
lines: A moving joint does not wait for you.
运动中的关节不会等你。
Apply a target late, and the joint is behind by speed × lateness.
目标晚一点生效，关节就落后：落后量 = 速度 × 晚了多久。
A machine tool at F1000 moves 1000 mm per minute: about 16.7 mm per second.
机床走 F1000：每分钟 1000 毫米，约每秒 16.7 毫米。
1 ms late: 16.7 mm/s × 0.001 s ≈ 0.017 mm, about 17 µm.
A robot joint turning 180° per second: 1 ms late is 0.18°.
机器人关节每秒转 180°：晚 1 毫秒就是 0.18°。
At the end of a 0.5 m arm, 0.18° is about 1.6 mm.
在 0.5 米长的手臂末端，0.18° 约等于 1.6 毫米。
For a moving machine, a timing error is a position error.
对运动中的机器来说，时间误差就是位置误差。

title: Two kinds of timing error
lines: Timing can go wrong in two different ways.
时间可以错在两个地方。
Skew: within one cycle, J1 and J2 act at different moments.
偏差（skew）：同一个周期里，J1 和 J2 动作的时刻不一样。
Jitter: the cycle itself wobbles. 1 ms becomes 0.8, then 1.2.
抖动（jitter）：周期本身在晃。1 毫秒一会儿变 0.8，一会儿变 1.2。
Skew makes the joints disagree with each other.
偏差让关节之间对不上。
Jitter makes the whole motion stumble, even when the joints agree.
抖动让整个动作磕磕绊绊，哪怕关节彼此一致。
Like a band that plays together, but follows a conductor whose beat wobbles.
像一支乐队：大家彼此很齐，但指挥的拍子忽快忽慢。

title: How CANopen handles it
lines: Send each motor its command in turn, and the first moves before the last one hears.
如果挨个给电机发命令，第一个已经动了，最后一个才收到。
That is skew. CANopen's CSP mode fixes it with one broadcast.
这就是偏差。CANopen 的 CSP 模式用一条广播来解决。
First each drive gets its target. Then one SYNC message, ID 0x80, says: everyone, go.
先把目标分别发给每个驱动器，再发一条 SYNC 报文（ID 0x80）：大家一起动。
One message reaches every drive together, so skew is small.
一条报文同时到达所有驱动器，偏差就小了。
But when does SYNC leave? When the master's software timer fires.
但 SYNC 什么时候发出？取决于主站的软件定时器。
If the bus is busy, SYNC waits. One 8-byte CAN frame takes about 0.1 ms at 1 Mbit/s.
总线正忙，SYNC 就得等。1 Mbit/s 下，一个 8 字节的 CAN 帧约要 0.1 毫秒。
Then each drive reacts through an interrupt, which adds its own delay.
每个驱动器还要经过中断才响应，又添一段延迟。
So SYNC fixes skew, not jitter. Every drive inherits the master's wobble.
所以 SYNC 治了偏差，治不了抖动：每个驱动器都继承了主站的晃动。

title: Guess first
lines: Back on our line. First, the drives act the moment new targets arrive.
回到我们的总线。先让驱动器在新目标到达的那一刻动作。
The master tries to send exactly every 1 ms.
主站尽量每 1 毫秒准时发一次。
Guess: how far from 1 ms will the real cycles land?
猜一猜：实际的周期会偏离 1 毫秒多少？
pause

title: The real run
lines: 3 seconds of running: about 2,500 cycles measured at J1.
运行 3 秒：在 J1 上测到约 2500 个周期。
Most cycles stay near 1 ms. But some come hundreds of microseconds early or late.
大多数周期在 1 毫秒附近，但总有一些早到或晚到几百微秒。
The spread, one standard deviation, is tens of microseconds, in every run.
离散程度（一个标准差）每次运行都是几十微秒。
The wobble comes from the master: an ordinary Mac, not a real-time system.
这些晃动来自主站：一台普通的 Mac，不是实时系统。
A real-time OS makes it much smaller, but never zero.
换成实时操作系统能小很多，但永远不会是零。
Now J1 against J2: they act 310 ns apart, in every cycle.
再看 J1 和 J2 之间：每个周期都相差 310 纳秒。
310 ns is the simulated cable and chip delay. One frame passes J1, then J2.
310 纳秒是模拟的网线加芯片延迟：同一帧先经过 J1，再经过 J2。
So skew is tiny. Episode 3 shows how one frame does that.
所以偏差很小。一帧怎么做到这一点，第 3 集再讲。
But the jitter goes straight through to the motors.
可是抖动原封不动地传给了电机。
At 180°/s, a cycle 0.2 ms late leaves J1 0.036° behind: about 0.3 mm at the arm tip.
以每秒 180° 计，晚到 0.2 毫秒的周期让 J1 落后 0.036°，在手臂末端约 0.3 毫米。

title: What EtherCAT does instead
lines: Same line, one change: each drive acts on its own clock.
同一条总线，只改一处：每个驱动器按自己的时钟动作。
Every slave chip has a clock. EtherCAT keeps all those clocks in step.
每个从站芯片里都有一个时钟。EtherCAT 让这些时钟步调一致。
This is called the Distributed Clock, DC for short.
这叫分布式时钟（Distributed Clock），简称 DC。
Every 1 ms by its own clock, each drive fires a pulse called SYNC0, and acts on it.
每个驱动器按自己的时钟，每 1 毫秒产生一个叫 SYNC0 的脉冲，就在这一刻动作。
The frame only has to arrive before SYNC0. Exactly when no longer matters.
帧只要在 SYNC0 之前到就行，具体哪一刻到已经无所谓。
Same master, same Mac, the sending still wobbles.
主站还是那台 Mac，发送照样在晃。
Cycle spread at the drives: about 5 ns, in every run.
驱动器上的周期离散：约 5 纳秒，每次运行都一样。
Once the clocks settle, J1 and J2 act within about 10 ns of each other.
时钟稳定下来以后，J1 和 J2 动作的时刻相差在 10 纳秒左右。
From tens of microseconds to a few nanoseconds: about ten thousand times tighter.
从几十微秒到几纳秒：大约收紧了一万倍。
Note: how fast the clocks settle comes from our simulated chip, not a real one.
注意：时钟多快能稳定，取决于我们模拟的芯片，不是某款真实芯片的数据。

title: How is that possible?
lines: Getting there takes four questions, one at a time.
要做到这一点，需要回答四个问题，一个一个来。
How is one cable already a ring? Episode 2.
一根网线，怎么就已经是一个环？第 2 集。
How does one frame serve every slave without stopping? Episode 3.
一帧怎么不停下来，就服务了每一个从站？第 3 集。
How does the line start up and agree who sends what? Episode 4.
总线怎么启动，怎么约定谁收发哪些数据？第 4 集。
How do clocks in different chips agree to a few nanoseconds? Episode 5.
不同芯片里的时钟，怎么对齐到几纳秒？第 5 集。

title: Recap
lines: One: for a moving machine, timing error is position error. Speed × time.
一、对运动中的机器，时间误差就是位置误差：速度 × 时间。
Two: skew and jitter differ. One is between joints, the other is the beat itself.
二、偏差和抖动是两回事：一个在关节之间，一个是节拍本身。
Three: acting when a message arrives inherits the sender's jitter. A shared clock removes it.
三、收到报文就动作，会继承发送方的抖动；共享的时钟才能去掉它。

title: Your turn
lines: A joint turns at 90° per second. One cycle arrives 0.3 ms late.
一个关节每秒转 90°，某个周期晚到了 0.3 毫秒。
How far behind is it, in degrees?
它落后了多少度？
pause
Next: one cable, and why it is already a ring.
下一集：一根网线，为什么它已经是一个环。
